meta.title: Hájsky dvor — 1857 cottage near the Háj Waterfalls
meta.desc: An 1857 house in the village of Háj in the Slovak Karst, all yours for up to 11 guests. Hot tub and sauna included, kids' corner, edible garden and fireplace. Close to the Háj Waterfalls, about 45 min from Košice.
hero.eyebrow: Háj · Slovak Karst · about 45 min from Košice
hero.h1: The whole cottage for your family, close to the waterfalls
hero.lead: An 1857 house we brought back to life with our own hands. All yours for up to 11 guests, with a kids' corner, an edible garden and a fenced yard. The hot tub and sauna are included in your stay.
hero.badge: Walk to the Háj WaterfallsThe Háj Valley starts right in the village.
f1s: the whole cottage just for you
wk.h2: Midweek is the loveliest time here
wk.lead: While everyone else waits for the weekend, you have the waterfalls, trails and castle almost to yourselves. Perfect for mums on maternity leave with little ones, grandparents with grandchildren, or families during the school holidays.
wk.1s: Walk the gorge at your own pace, with no crowds on the footbridges and ladders.
wk.2t: Easier to find a free date
wk.2s: Weekends go fast; weekdays tend to be freer, often even at the last minute.
wk.3t: Hot tub and sauna every evening, included
wk.3s: After a whole day outdoors the kids fall asleep fast, and you get to enjoy warm water under the stars.
ab.h2: A house that came back to life
ab.p1: In the heart of the Slovak Karst, where silence mingles with the scent of lime and herbs, stands a cottage with a soul. Not a hotel. Not a guesthouse. A home – and for a little while, yours too.
ab.p1b: The house was built in 1857, and we carefully restored it with our own hands. Lime plaster, clay walls and wooden beams make staying here an experience. Every detail has its own story and its own time.
ab.p2: You rent the whole cottage just for yourselves. A living room with a fireplace and sofa, a fully equipped kitchen with a dining area, a terrace and a fenced garden where the kids can run around safely. Free parking right by the house.
rm.note: Min. 2 nights. No pets allowed. Free parking by the house. Prices are listed on the booking portals.
wl.eyebrow: Relaxation for grown-ups, fun for kids
wl.h2: A hot tub, a sauna and a garden you can taste
wl.lead: While the kids play in the garden, you soak in the hot tub and can still keep an eye on them. The hot tub and sauna are included in your stay. Then in the evening, everyone gathers by the fireplace.
wl.1p: Hot water under the open sky with a view of the hills, in summer and winter alike. Included in your stay.
wl.2p: To warm up after a hike to the waterfalls or up to Turňa Castle. Included in your stay.
wl.3p: A play space for the little ones and a fenced yard where you can always keep an eye on them.
wl.4p: Flowers, herbs and fruit. Taste whatever has just ripened. Here the kids discover that strawberries don't grow in shops.
gl.h2: Take a look inside and out
mp.lead: The whole property is fenced, so the kids can run freely and you can always keep an eye on them.
mp.l1: House with 4 bedrooms, kitchen and fireplace
ok.h2: A reason to come in every season
ok.lead: The Slovak Karst is beautiful all year round. Here are places you can visit with kids too. Distances are as the crow flies; by car it's further.
tip.1p: A gorge with footbridges and ladders that starts right in the village. Most beautiful in spring, when there's the most water.
tip.1k: 👶 the ladders suit older kids best
tip.2p: A ruin above Turňa nad Bodvou with a view over the whole basin. A short climb, a big experience.
tip.2k: 👶 shorter hike, fine for little ones too
tip.3p: One of the deepest canyons in Slovakia, with the Cukrová homoľa (Sugar Loaf) rock needle. An easy path runs along the valley floor.
tip.4p: A travertine waterfall near Hrhov. Easy to combine with a trip to Zádiel or the castle.
tip.5p: A show cave with dripstone formations, and close by the Baroque Jasov Manor. A good plan even when it rains.
tip.6p: Two UNESCO-listed caves. In Domica, part of the tour is by boat along the underground Styx river; Gombasek enchants with its delicate soda-straw stalactites.
tip.6k: 👶 an experience for the whole family
tip.7p: The castle above Krásnohorské Podhradie and the Art Nouveau Andrássy Mausoleum, one of the most beautiful in Slovakia.
tip.8p: The Andrássy family manor with a vast English-style park. Easy to combine with Krásna Hôrka in one day.
tip.9p: An ice cave where the ice lasts even in summer, and a karst plateau with views across the countryside.
tip.9k: ☀️ cool off on a hot day
tip.10p: The Granárium, an Esterházy granary, and the stone viaduct near Jablonov nad Turňou. Short stops you can combine with a trip to the castle.
tip.11p: The historic centre, the Singing Fountain and, in December, the Christmas markets. A half-day trip to the city.
tip.12h: A day at home in the yard
tip.12p: Sometimes the best trip is no trip at all. The garden, games with the kids, the sauna and the hot tub in the evening, plus the fireplace on chilly days.
ok.more: More tips from Denisa and Tomáš:

ct.p: We're a married couple who decided to share the experience of our own renovation. We'd love to bring you a little piece of history and of this beautiful region. We believe you'll find just what you're looking for here.
ct.lang: We speak Englishas well as Slovak, Hungarian and Spanish.
